description: Stop one job alert by its id, on every channel or on the one named. Deletes the alert's delivery on those channels and their record of matches; the saved search itself stays on the account as a bookmarked search. To hold an alert for a while, pause it with update_subscription instead.

channel.description: Stop only this channel. Omit for all.

id.description: The alert id, from list_subscriptions or subscribe.

name: unsubscribe
